sources.scope: Every one of the 50 donor file-family Java sources, with explicit package/owner mappings; supporting Java and native donor paths are pinned in the component receipts.

Existing actual compiler M3AST owner, source retention hook and module services.

ownership.text_authority: Public java.lang.String; matched M3JDK supplies the internal M3String representation.
ownership.file_text: M3FileText implements CharSequence and retains resolver/packed-ID/composition/metric metadata, with no second retained character or byte payload owner.
ownership.compiler: Existing com.sun.source.util.M3AST and real javac tree/task. Consumer projections are per instance and callback event; no retained Unit/tree/task.
ownership.source_identity: Exact compiler big-endian UTF-16 SHA-256 including unpaired surrogates; separate from attributed/classpath equivalence.
ownership.library_formats: OpenNLP supplies UTF-16 spans; Lucene owns term buffers, UTF-8 term encoding and persisted index format.
ownership.transactions: API caller owns writer/resolver/commit. CLI snapshots M3File inputs, disables commit-on-close and explicitly commits only a successful complete parse batch.

native_workers.scope: Mapped file token search, JSON byte classification and direct text metrics with synchronous borrowed-pointer lifetimes.

build_modes.normal: Supply an already built M3JDK21 exposing the actual M3AST compiler API and matching hook; no compiler-source-proof option.
build_modes.compiler_source_proof: Explicit --compiler-source-proof compiles the five locked compiler inputs, rebuilds their module/hash metadata and runs the complete receiver on the supplied stock Java21 String/HotSpot.
build_modes.runtime_option_scope: Primary candidate launches and the matching reader baseline; OpenNLP diagnostic child and shared compiler verification harness have separate invocation scopes.
